inference_time.note: single core, includes Python call overhead and Obs construction; control period 8000 us

notes.design: see candidate2_learned.py docstring; iteration log candidate2_log.md
notes.policy: one shared policy for T1 and T3 (both doses), trained on train split scenes, selected on dev (seed 2000) subject to peak<=7 N in >=95% of the 20-scene train cohorts (seed 1000)
notes.test_protocol: 40 test scenes per cell, scenarios.cohort(task,40,3000,dose), noise seeds 3000+i, PC125; B1, B3b@0.1 and EtR-A re-run on the same scenes (reproduce README numbers); per-seed and seed-averaged paired bootstrap CIs (tune.paired_ci)
notes.budget_per_seed: full/c/d/e: 8 DAgger iterations x 32 episodes + 50 ES generations x (16x8 + 8 reference) episodes + selection episodes = 8104 episodes; a (no teacher): 7288 episodes; ~5 min wall each on 2 processes
notes.infeasible: d (all seeds) and e (seeds 1, 2) never met the train peak rule; their saved model is the last DAgger iterate (fallback) and is reported anyway
notes.c_seed0: ES did not improve dev, so c seed 0 is the stage-1 checkpoint (identical to b seed 0); the u residual head is never distilled, so c differs from full only in stage 2
notes.secondary_cell: T3 ramp 0.25 s, A 1 mm: EtR-A row uses the T3 ramp-0.5 tuning (no tuning exists for this cell); the policy was trained on ramps 0.2-0.6 s
notes.inference: policy_call_us_per_tick includes the lock-in front end, features, MLP and Python/Obs overhead (min of 3 replays); control period 8000 us
